rules.statement: The High Court should not summarily reject an application for enforcement of an arbitral award without giving an opportunity to tender duly certified copies, even if the copy of the award filed with the application is not a duly certified copy.
rules.supporting_quote: The claimant should have been given an opportunity to tender duly certified copies interpreting “accompany” in section 31 (2) purposively and widely (as in Sri Lanka General Workers’ Union v Samaranayake and Nagappa Chettiar v. Commissioner of Income Tax.)
